scenario: AITA if I don’t want my son to speak Spanish with his father | You’ll see, my husband’s parents are both from Argentina, this means that he is very connected to their culture and even speaks Spanish fluently. But recently he has started to speak Spanish with his father at home. For example when he wants my husband to help him he calls him in Spanish, when they are doing something together they talk Spanish or when we are in the living room but and I’m reading a book they have conversations in Spanish. It feels like they are excluding me, or like they didn’t want me to understand them. I was really scared until I realized my son had lost his book. I was really angry after this, I didn’t knew what had happened and my husband didn’t even told me. I told him that he couldn’t speak Spanish with our son anymore, except when they were practicing it, I’m done with being left out. My husband is really angry at me but accept it. But my son didn’t, he know refuses to speak with me and only speaks with my husband. I understand that my son liked it but it was really uncomfortable to not know what my own son was saying.
